d: These are snippets of an old comic from Rosvo's DA page, which is now, apparently lost to time. It is no longer available on their page, neither is it found in their archive. I used to have it on my old computer, and had cropped them to put these on a handheld. Now, my computer is lost with no chance of recovery. For some strange reason, I haven't been able to find the original comic that went with these images. I even reached out to Rosvo and Jimryu, with no luck. I would put these on a bounty, but I had this account created just recently, and do not have the credits or hath at the moment. I will not stop anyone from using these images if they plan to make a bounty themselves. I just want the comic recovered.
